EHCP models quarterback decision quality using expected hypothetical completion probability, derived from BART and Bayesian logistic regression. It quantifies how likely a pass will complete based on contextual features. The bootstrap method adjusts for temporal and spatial dependencies in game data, yielding effective sample sizes that reflect true independence. This correction is essential for valid statistical inference in sports analytics. Kernel Rank Centrality (KRC) extends traditional centrality measures into dynamic networks, capturing evolving team strengths through kernel-smoothed adjacency matrices. These primitives form a coherent framework for modeling both individual decision-making and collective team dynamics in GSI’s Bayesian inference and GSE’s situational reasoning engines.
